summary.zh-CN:
### 新功能

- Agents Window：顶栏新增入口，把主窗口切换为整窗 Agent 工作区。左侧栏按 Agent 列出会话历史，打开的会话以标签页并排排列，模型和协作选项收进输入框底栏，会话列可居中调整宽度；侧栏 Agent 节点恢复为普通文件夹展开。
- 译文归档：全文译文保存到论文目录的 `translations/translated.pdf`，双语导出去 `translations/bilingual.pdf`，导出对话框默认打开该目录。
- 译文同步：同步范围新增「译文」并默认关闭；即使 PDF、源码和附件全开，译文目录也不会进入 Git 同步。

### 改进

- 顶栏快速打开：命令面板改为顶栏内联搜索框，结果在下方展开且不铺遮罩；`Cmd+P`、`Shift+Cmd+P`、`Esc`、点击外部和键盘导航保持可用。

### 修复

- 版面元素框选：`⌘.` 在译文上框选时只保留框覆盖的版面块，擦到下一节边界不会带入整句，确实覆盖两节时两节都保留。拖选范围按实际渲染行计算，点击和悬停落在句子上，保存的高亮在同页重新匹配。
- 行间公式与正文选区：无编号的行间公式可点选，悬停显示 Formula；从公式起笔时保留指针下的公式。正文行不再被误判为行间公式，高亮不再挖掉句中的词，字母下伸部分留在选区内。
- 侧栏复制路径：译文 PDF 获得焦点后仍可从侧栏复制论文路径，已打开的 PDF 选区不会覆盖这次复制。
- Windows Claude 检测：PATH 中残留的 `claude.cmd` 不再遮住原生 `claude.exe`，检测会取第一个可启动的入口；`CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE` 显式指定但不可用时直接报错。
- 译文面板随正文关闭：关闭正文标签时成对关闭对照译文页，单独关闭 NOTES 或译文页仍保留正文。
- 回收站清理译文缓存：论文进入回收站后删除其 `reflow-ir` 目录，并按内容哈希清理对应的 `reflow-build` 译文 PDF；未映射的哈希与字体保留到整批清除。

### 破坏性变更

- 移除 Azure 与 Google Cloud 翻译引擎：两个 BYOK 提供商及其设置项、CLI 配置字段一并删除，已保存的选择回退到默认引擎。
summary.en:
### Features

- Agents Window: a title-bar entry switches the main window into a full-window Agents workspace. The left rail lists conversation history per agent, open conversations become side-by-side tabs, model and collaboration controls move into the composer footer, and the conversation column can be centered and resized. The sidebar Agent node expands like a normal folder again.
- Translation storage: finished translations are written to `translations/translated.pdf` in the paper folder, bilingual exports go to `translations/bilingual.pdf`, and the export dialog opens there by default.
- Translation sync: sync gains a Translation scope that is off by default; the translation directory stays out of Git sync even when PDF, source, and attachments are all enabled.

### Improvements

- Title-bar quick open: the command palette is now an inline search field in the title bar. Results drop below it without a scrim, and `Cmd+P`, `Shift+Cmd+P`, `Esc`, click-outside, and keyboard navigation keep working.

### Fixes

- Element-selection bounds: `Cmd+.` selection over translated text keeps only the layout blocks the rectangle covers; grazing the next section no longer pulls in a whole sentence, while a rectangle that truly covers two sections keeps both. Drag hits are measured from rendered lines, click and hover land on the chosen sentence, and saved highlights match on the page.
- Display formulas and prose selections: unnumbered display formulas can be selected and show a Formula label on hover, and a drag that starts on a formula keeps the formula under the pointer. Prose lines are no longer mistaken for display formulas, highlights no longer cut words out of a sentence, and descenders stay inside the selection.
- Sidebar path copy: copying a paper path from the sidebar still works while a translated PDF has focus, and an open PDF selection no longer replaces that copy.
- Claude detection on Windows: a leftover `claude.cmd` no longer hides a native `claude.exe`; detection keeps the first PATH entry the SDK can spawn, and an explicit but unusable `CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE` fails instead of falling back.
- Translation pane closes with the paper body: closing the body tab also closes its comparison translation pane; closing NOTES or the translation pane alone leaves the body open.
- Trash clears translation cache: moving a paper to the trash deletes its `reflow-ir` directory and removes matching `reflow-build` translation PDFs by content hash; unmapped hashes and fonts stay until a full cache clear.

### Breaking Changes

- Azure and Google Cloud translation engines removed: both BYOK providers are gone along with their settings and CLI profile fields, and stored selections fall back to the default engine.

summary.zh-CN:
### 新功能

- 广场的 Hugging Face 每日论文默认显示热门榜，可切换每日、每周和每月，支持关键词搜索、二次排序，以及一键在工作区打开 PDF。
- 译文模式中，中键点击译文分块，可在只读卡片中查看对应的英文原文，不触发翻译或网络请求。
- 普通 Markdown 笔记的工具栏新增「打开方式」，可打开笔记所在文件夹，或用文件管理器、已安装的编辑器和终端打开。
- 选择北京大学 WPN 预设时会验证已保存的会话：需要认证时自动打开北大统一身份认证，已有有效会话则直接复用。
- 论文库的文件夹卡片重新设计：点击卡片上部进入文件夹，点击下部切换选中，悬停时在右下角显示选择按钮和「更多操作」。
- Windows 上，系统标题栏并入应用顶栏，窗口不再显示两条叠放的标题栏。

### 修复

- 对照阅读时，双栏的滚动和缩放保持同步，一栏顶部的路径条不再使另一栏内容错位。
- 句子悬停高亮在版面分析完成后才启用，不再跨栏、跨页出现灰带；拖选时行内公式可以选中，不再被当作独立公式丢掉。
- 悬停补充材料图号（如 `Supplementary Figure N`、`Fig. SN`）时显示补充图预览，不再误裁主图；PLOS 的补充材料链接可直接预览。
- 开关侧栏使笔记窗格变宽或变窄时，阅读位置保持在原来的字符处。
- Markdown 图片的 alt 文字在渲染结果和选中提示中保留；`![alt](<含空格的路径>)` 这类尖括号写法可以正常显示图片。
- Agent 聊天里带端口号的地址可以完整显示并点击，URL 作为链接文字时不再被二次包装。
- 精读生成的 `NOTES.md` 的章节标题由 `paper-reader` Skill 决定，正文语言仍跟随应用语言。
summary.en:
### Features

- Hugging Face Daily Papers in the Plaza opens on the Trending feed and can switch between daily, weekly, and monthly views, with keyword search, secondary sorting, and one-click PDF opening in the workspace.
- In translated view, middle-click a translated block to read its English source in a read-only card without triggering translation or network requests.
- The toolbar for plain Markdown notes adds Open With, which opens the note's folder or sends the note to a file manager, an installed editor, or the terminal.
- Selecting the Peking University WPN preset validates the saved session and opens PKU unified authentication when needed. A valid session is reused directly.
- Folder cards in the paper library are redesigned: click the upper part of a card to enter it, click the lower part to toggle selection, and hover to reveal the selection button and More Actions in the lower-right corner.
- Windows windows merge the system title bar into the app header and no longer show two stacked bars.

### Fixes

- In side-by-side reading, both panes scroll and zoom in step, and the path bar above one pane no longer shifts the other pane's content.
- Sentence hover highlighting waits for layout analysis and no longer shades both columns or adjacent pages. Inline formulas can be selected in drag selections instead of being dropped as display formulas.
- Hovering a supplement figure label such as `Supplementary Figure N` or `Fig. SN` previews the supplement instead of cropping the main figure. PLOS supplement links preview directly.
- When opening or closing a sidebar resizes the note pane, the reading position stays on the same character.
- Markdown image alt text is preserved in rendering and in the selection hint, and angle-bracket destinations such as `![alt](<path with spaces>)` render as images.
- URLs with ports in agent chats display and open correctly, and a URL used as link text is no longer wrapped a second time.
- Section headings in `NOTES.md` written by the paper reader follow the `paper-reader` skill, while the body language still follows the app language.

summary.zh-CN:
### 新功能

- 新建 PDF 批注时，编辑框会在选区旁打开。批注默认显示为右侧卡片，也可在外观设置中改为页边图标，悬停预览，点击编辑。
- PDF 可关闭默认开启的句子悬停高亮。关闭后，双击选中单词，拖选底色也会变浅。
- 桌面端的本地知识库可从 AlphaXiv 导入私人高亮、批注和笔记，也可为已入库论文补导。能定位的高亮显示在 PDF 中，其余摘录和独立笔记存入 `NOTES.md`。
- 右键点击论文库空白处，可从 AlphaXiv 或 Zotero 导入新论文到当前文件夹，也可启动 Zotero 同步以更新已有条目。

### 修复

- 对照阅读时，原文高亮会标到对应译句，已保存高亮的工具栏会避开被标注文字。
- 译文中的引用和链接恢复悬停与点击，编号引文保留原文方括号。升级后首次打开已有译文时，会用缓存译文重新生成 PDF。
- Zotero 迁移会保留原生引用键，并读取旧版 Zotero 的 Extra 字段中固定的 Better BibTeX 引用键。
- WebDAV 服务器缺少强 ETag 时，已开启降级同步的设备可以继续同步。无法更新远端索引的备份镜像会在上传前停止。
- 内建知乎 Agent 可正确通过问题诊断。知识库位于用户主目录下时，Pi 的项目授权检查会在主目录停止。
summary.en:
### Features

- New PDF annotation editors open beside the selection. Notes appear in cards on the right by default. Switch to page-margin icons in Appearance settings to preview notes on hover and edit them on click.
- PDF sentence hover highlighting is on by default and can be turned off. With it off, double-click selects a word and drag selection uses a lighter tint.
- Import private AlphaXiv highlights, annotations, and notes into a local desktop vault, including for papers already in the library. Highlights that can be placed appear in the PDF. Other excerpts and standalone notes go into `NOTES.md`.
- Right-click empty space in the library to import new papers from AlphaXiv or Zotero into the current folder, or run Zotero sync to update existing entries.

### Fixes

- In side-by-side reading, source highlights mark the corresponding translated sentence. The toolbar for saved highlights stays clear of the marked text.
- Hover and click work again on translated citations and links, and numbered citations retain their original square brackets. Opening an existing translation for the first time after upgrading rebuilds its PDF from cached translations.
- Zotero migration preserves native citation keys and reads pinned Better BibTeX citation keys from the Extra field in older Zotero libraries.
- Devices with degraded sync enabled can sync with WebDAV servers that lack strong ETags. Backup mirrors that cannot update their remote index stop before uploading.
- Doctor reports the built-in Zhihu agent correctly. For vaults under the user's home directory, Pi's project trust check stops at that directory.

summary.zh-CN:
### 新功能

- 论文库默认显示卡片，可预览 PDF 首页、管理文件夹和批量处理论文。已保存的表格视图偏好会保留。
- 知识库可配置最多三个单向备份镜像，镜像端的改动不会同步回本地。
- 不支持条件写入的 WebDAV 服务器可开启降级同步。共享该存储的每台设备都需单独开启；降级后仍可能产生冲突副本，已删除的文件也可能重新出现。WebDAV 另支持双向手动覆盖，确认前可预览受影响的文件数量。
- 更新提示可查看对应版本的双语说明，设置中也可以浏览历史更新。
- 机构代理新增北京大学 WPN 预设；访问学位论文全文仍需北大统一身份认证。

### 改进

- 界面缩放可输入 50%–200%，按回车或离开输入框后生效。
- 打开 Agent 侧栏时更快显示面板，论文库、阅读器、写作和设置在加载时保留占位。

### 修复

- 对照阅读时，双击译文可选中整句，即使焦点仍在原文栏。
- 修复中国知网 Wengine 代理地址编码，以及 Git 备份镜像无法发布到指定分支的问题。
summary.en:
### Features

- The paper library opens in card view by default, with PDF first-page previews, folder management, and batch actions. Saved table-view preferences are preserved.
- Configure up to three one-way vault backup mirrors. Changes made on a mirror are never synced back.
- Opt in to degraded sync on WebDAV servers without conditional writes. Each device sharing the store must enable it separately; conflict copies may still be created, and deleted files may reappear. WebDAV also supports manual overwrite in either direction, with a preview of affected file counts before confirmation.
- Read bilingual notes for the available update and browse past releases in Settings.
- Use the new Peking University WPN proxy preset. Full-text dissertations still require PKU unified authentication.

### Improvements

- Enter an interface scale from 50% to 200% and apply it by pressing Enter or leaving the field.
- The Agent panel opens sooner, and the library, reader, writing, and settings views keep placeholders while loading.

### Fixes

- Double-click a translated sentence in side-by-side view to select it in full, even when the source pane still has focus.
- Fixed CNKI Wengine proxy address encoding and Git backup mirrors failing to publish to the configured branch.

summary.zh-CN:
### 新功能

- 桌面 Agent、CLI 和 MCP 共用论文、笔记、批注和表格操作。CLI 命令、MCP 工具和资源已调整，已有调用需要迁移。MCP 默认只读，写入、联网和读取全文需分别授权。
- 广场新增 Hugging Face 每日论文，论文库支持从 AlphaXiv 批量导入。导入遇到 OpenReview 或 Cloudflare 验证时，可在桌面弹窗中完成验证。
- PDF 支持外链悬停预览；Linux 可识别已安装的桌面应用并复用其自带 CLI。

### 改进

- 对照阅读时，悬停原文句子会高亮对应译文。重新打开全文译文时可复用排版，新安装默认使用哔哩哔哩 Translate 2B。

### 修复

- 修复全文翻译中断、译文提示词回显及 PDF 批注公式显示问题。笔记加载失败时仍可阅读正文。
summary.en:
### Features

- Desktop agents, the CLI, and MCP share operations for papers, notes, annotations, and tables. Existing callers need to migrate to the reorganized CLI commands, MCP tools, and resources. MCP is read-only by default; writes, network access, and full-text reads require separate grants.
- Plaza adds Hugging Face Daily Papers, and the library supports bulk imports from AlphaXiv. Complete OpenReview or Cloudflare verification in a desktop popup when an import requires it.
- Preview external links on PDF hover. On Linux, Agentero detects installed desktop apps and can reuse their bundled CLIs.

### Improvements

- Hover over a source sentence in side-by-side view to highlight the matching translation. Reopen full-document translations without repeating layout when the previous layout is available. New installations default to Bilibili Translate 2B.

### Fixes

- Fixed interruptions and prompt echoes in full-document translation, and formula rendering in PDF annotations. The paper stays readable if its notes fail to load.

summary.zh-CN:
### 新功能

- PDF 可切换**原文、译文和对照**，也可以进入沉浸式全屏。
- 选中版面元素即可翻译、加入对话或添加批注。
- 设置新增本机使用情况看板；写作编译错误可以交给 Agent 修复。

### 改进

- 每页都能单独翻译、隐藏或重译，并显示翻译与排版进度。

### 修复

- 修复 PDF 正文提取、译文排版和引用图表预览中的多处问题。
summary.en:
### Features

- Switch PDF views between **original, translation, and side by side**, or read in immersive full screen.
- Select a page element to translate it, add it to a chat, or annotate it.
- View local usage in Settings and send writing build errors to an agent.

### Improvements

- Translate, hide, or retranslate individual pages and see translation and layout progress.

### Fixes

- Fixed PDF text extraction, translated layouts, and figure previews in citations.

summary.zh-CN:
### 新功能

- 内置离线词典和 AI 术语库。Zotero 导入可保留 PDF 高亮与下划线。
- 可以复制已渲染公式的 LaTeX；新增 Windows ARM64 安装包与 CLI。

### 修复

- 更新术语库后保留已有译文，修复翻译进度及目录、公式和表格的排版。
- 修复 Linux AppImage 中依赖 Node.js 的 Agent 无法启动的问题。
summary.en:
### Features

- Look up words offline and use the built-in AI glossary. Zotero imports preserve PDF highlights and underlines.
- Copy LaTeX from rendered equations. Windows ARM64 installers and CLI builds are available.

### Fixes

- Glossary updates preserve existing translations. Fixed translation progress and layout for contents, equations, and tables.
- Fixed startup for Node.js agents in the Linux AppImage.

summary.zh-CN:
### 新功能

- Zen 支持同时保留多个 Agent 会话；PDF 支持下划线标注。
- 选中一到三个词可查词。Index-Translate 提供无需密钥的翻译。

### 修复

- 修复目录与行内公式的译文排版，减少版面识别错误导致的正文漏译。

### 升级须知

- Google 翻译和 DeepLX 已移除。使用这两个服务的用户需在设置中选择其他翻译服务。
summary.en:
### Features

- Keep multiple agent sessions open in Zen and underline text in PDFs.
- Look up a selection of one to three words. Index-Translate offers translation without an API key.

### Fixes

- Fixed translated layouts for contents and inline equations and reduced missed text caused by layout detection.

### Upgrade notes

- Google Translate and DeepLX were removed. If you used either service, choose another provider in Settings.

summary.zh-CN:
### 新功能

- PDF 选区可以跨页复制、高亮或翻译；阅读器支持 Vim 键盘导航。
- 论文库支持框选多篇论文并执行批量操作。
- PDF 评论卡片支持 Markdown 编辑，批注支持撤销和重做。

### 修复

- 完整的缓存译文可直接打开；补译缺失内容时保留已完成的译文。
- 多个 PDF 阅读器的翻译选区互不干扰。
summary.en:
### Features

- Select across PDF pages to copy, highlight, or translate, and navigate PDFs with Vim keys.
- Drag to select multiple papers in the library and run bulk actions.
- Edit PDF comments in Markdown and undo or redo annotation changes.

### Fixes

- Open completed cached translations directly. Filling gaps preserves text that was already translated.
- Translation selections in separate PDF readers no longer interfere with one another.
